description: Located in the heart of Paris's 9th arrondissement, 90m², this apartment is ideally situated in the Opéra – Grands Boulevards district. Located on the 4th floor with elevator access. It comfortably accommodates up to 8 guests, perfect for a groups of friends, business travelers and for families with little ones. Fully equipped and carefully prepared for your arrival.This apartment, in a typical Haussmann building, has been entirely reimagined by Habitat Parisien design team.The spaceDesigned for comfort, this 90m² apartment includes everything you need for a relaxing stay in Paris:- A welcoming living area with sofa bed- Fully equipped kitchen (essentials provided, coffee, tea, sugar, washer / dishwasher tablets, etc...)- 3 bedrooms with comfortable double beds- Air conditioning- High-speed broadband Wi-Fi- Connected TV- Washing machine (solid detergent provided)- Iron & ironing board- Hair dryer- Bed linen and bath towels- 2 en-suite bathrooms with WC, 1 independent toilet - Towels and essentials by "Codage"- Complimentary baby travel cot and highchair - on requestThis setup ensures a comfortable and functional stay for up to 8 guests.Housekeeping is ensured once, before your arrival.Please note: pets and smoking are not permitted.Guest accessSelf check-in 24/7.Guests have total access to the apartment.
